summary: MailerSend migration (js/mailer.js) backend-only verification. All 6 requested checks PASS: unit suite 16/16; live no-send check -> MailError provider=mailersend status=422 code=MS42207, verifiedDomains()={test-z0vklo6kmd1l7qrx.mlsender.net} only; DNS dry run plans SPF merge 'v=spf1 include:spf.brevo.com include:_spf.mailersend.net ~all' + CNAMEs ms1/ms2._domainkey and mta, wrote nothing (GET-only path); all modules (auth, sms-service, send-email, mailer, vm-instance-setup) load and _index.js passes syntax check; /api/health 200, Alice login 200; stubbed auth.sendMail goes to MailerSend /v1/email (from hi@cloudivr.net, name CloudIVR, base64 mp3) when verified and to Brevo /v3/smtp/email (sender hi@cloudivr.net, attachment base64) when not; no 'Brevo' in js/lang/*.js and lang parity OK. No real emails sent, --apply not run, .env untouched.

minor.issue: If CLOUDIVR_MAIL_SENDER is set and only MAILERSEND_API_TOKEN exists (no BREVO_API_KEY), auth.sendMail now takes the mailer.send path; for an unverified domain sendBrevo throws 'BREVO_API_KEY is not set' instead of the old SMTP-relay path. Not hit in current env (Brevo key present).
Shim verify() always resolves true (no SMTP check). No current callers, but would mask SMTP misconfig if someone adds one.
Attachments with http(s) path or href are silently dropped (nodemailer would fetch them). No current caller uses this.

critical_code_review_comments: MailerSend custom 'headers' array and list_unsubscribe need Professional plan; until upgrade they may 422 — fallback covers it when MAIL_FALLBACK=brevo, but with MAIL_FALLBACK=off email-blast test sends would fail.
Retry on 429/5xx can block up to ~20s (2 retries, 10s cap) inside request paths (e.g. 2FA code send) — acceptable but consider fire-and-forget for non-critical mails.
sms-service forwardSmsToEmail interpolates raw SMS body into HTML without escaping (pre-existing, HTML injection into email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_mailersend_migration.py (wraps node suites). cloudivr.net NOT verified in MailerSend yet (only trial domain) — real sends go via Brevo by design. Never run scripts/mailersend_dns.js --apply or send real emails.
